access_policy.if_results_inform_future_revision: Retire this assessment as selection evidence and obtain fresh independent data; never reset access records or iterate to pass the same set.

assessment_requirements.auc: not applicable; no defined continuous ensemble score
assessment_requirements.cluster_uncertainty: 2000 fixed-seed source-component bootstrap replicates; degenerate intervals have null bounds, no zero-risk interpretation
assessment_requirements.mixed_controls: development-only unknown labels; excluded from precision/recall

authorship_qualification.reason: A descriptive pilot cannot certify general authorship accuracy. Existing validation shows poor recall; no calibrated probability or authorship determination is offered.

candidate.language_policy: unknown by default; no per-sample overrides
candidate.numeric_backend_thresholds: existing compiled constants; not selected or tuned in this assessment

limitations: Partial first-window HC3 and RAID views; not complete benchmark or random population sample.
Source-correlated answers and uneven domain/generator/length representation.
Fresh independent set contains no attack variants; old RAID paraphrase evidence is selection-only.
Mixed controls are mechanical concatenations, not verified real-world human-edited writing.
No independently labeled nonnative-speaker data; native status is not inferred.
Clean does not prove human authorship; common words and punctuation can occur in human writing.
Optional neural detectors, SAE inspection, MCP/TUI, and humanization remain deferred.
required_engineering_gates: Nine functional acceptance groups including clean offline package/install
Four real integration groups including pinned official SARIF schema
Exact manifest/config/criteria/binary binding and one-shot independent access
scope: One descriptive independent assessment of the existing offline heuristic policy; engineering release readiness is separate from authorship qualification.

selection.data: old RAID development/validation and fresh assessment development/validation only
selection.decision: Retain existing quorum2 and all default rules/thresholds; recall is poor and lowering quorum has a false-positive tradeoff.
